python_interfaces.name: DomainIdFactory
python_interfaces.contract: lowercase canonical UUIDv4 text; generated once; never derived from business/descriptive identifiers; all later domain LLDs reuse this convention unless an accepted requirement explicitly requires an external/business identity field in addition

python_interfaces.name: CustomerOrganizationRepository
python_interfaces.rule: no name-based identity API and no internal commit

python_interfaces.name: CustomerIdentifierRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Customer Account Code is external matching evidence; active canonical ownership is unique by normalized code but superseded claims remain history; no internal commit

python_interfaces.name: ContactRepository
python_interfaces.rule: affiliation mutation preserves same contact_id and closes prior current row rather than replacing identity

python_interfaces.name: ContactChannelRepository
python_interfaces.rule: channel values are reusable contact data/matching evidence, never login identity

python_interfaces.name: DispatchLocationRepository
python_interfaces.rule: contains no Customer Organization ownership field and never owns Site rows

python_interfaces.name: ReferenceMatcher
python_interfaces.rule: pure query; returns UNRESOLVED, UNIQUE_CANDIDATE or AMBIGUOUS; Customer Account Code is preferred evidence; matcher never selects/merges/mutates

python_interfaces.name: ReferenceDependencyValidator
python_interfaces.rule: validator queries only its own domain interfaces/tables using the caller's UnitOfWork; it never mutates during validation; result exposes has_blocker/exact_count and a deterministic bounded page rather than requiring unbounded materialization

python_interfaces.name: ReferenceDependencyRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: composition-root code owns deterministic validator registration; runtime plugins/arbitrary dynamic imports are not accepted authority

python_interfaces.name: DispatchLocationService
python_interfaces.rule: no internal commit; LLD-08 Site coordinator uses create_dedicated_for_site inside one cross-domain UoW, then LLD-08 owns the Site↔Dispatch Location relationship

python_interfaces.name: SiteDispatchAddressProvider
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-02 consumes derived Site context/address for display only; it never queries LLD-08 private tables directly

python_interfaces.name: SettingDefinitionRegistry
python_interfaces.rule: closed code-defined registry; unknown keys are rejected and do not become generic storage

python_interfaces.name: SettingStore
python_interfaces.rule: strict JSON validation delegates to LLD-01; reads never persist defaults

python_interfaces.name: LocalUserProfileIdentityStore
python_interfaces.rule: metadata identity only; verifier/password/auto-login remain LLD-12

candidate_result.rule: UNIQUE_CANDIDATE is a proposal result, not authorization to merge/link unless the consuming workflow's own contract permits acceptance; conflicts between stable account-code evidence and other exact candidate evidence produce AMBIGUOUS rather than silent precedence

dependency_check.rule: eligibility uses has_blocker/exact_count over the complete validator result, never only the visible page

repository_contract: all write methods receive LLD-01 UnitOfWork explicitly
static SQL and bound values only
repositories return LLD-02 value objects, not sqlite3.Row
cross-domain invariants use explicit interfaces rather than direct foreign-table access
